title: Microsoft AI chief says the company beat OpenAI at its own game, using a quarter of the computing power
key_facts: Suleyman said at a Thursday town hall Microsoft has a stronger pre-trained base model than the one behind GPT 5.6
He said it used one-quarter of the compute OpenAI used
Suleyman said Microsoft compared it privately with OpenAI models, including one nicknamed 'Spud'
Comparison rests on technical information Microsoft has about OpenAI's models
He also claimed 12 times less computation than DeepSeek, apparently DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base
Microsoft owns a stake in OpenAI likely worth over $100 billion; the relationship has frayed
quote_evidence: "We now have a stronger pre-trained base model than the model that currently powers GPT 5.6 Sol," Suleyman said.
"And in fact, we used one-quarter of the compute that OpenAI used to train their model."
why_it_matters_hint: If true, training top models gets much cheaper, and Microsoft needs OpenAI less.
notes: Full text read. Claims are Microsoft's own; Microsoft declined further comment.
